c74object.name: touch.mdial
c74object.digest: Multi-Dial Strip / Platter Array with MC Gain and Metering
c74object.description: A versatile multichannel rotary dial strip for Max 9 (v8ui / jsui) supporting up to 8 dials in horizontal, vertical, or zigzag offset arrangements. Features dual-domain output (linear list unpack alongside dedicated mc.line~ target ramps with phase-preserving power gain curves), liquid audio level metering, per-dial physics and typography, discrete touch stepping, and a popup inspector with HSV color pickers and precision bound tickers.

inlet.digest: Value input, meter list, tag messages, or configuration
inlet.description: Accepts floats to set the first dial, indexed lists [index value] to set a specific dial, lists of values across all dials, meter lists (0.0 to 1.0) for liquid audio feedback, [tag value] pairs matching dial labels, or configuration/theme messages.

outlet.description: Outputs an array of all current dial values mapped to their respective min_val and max_val ranges. Designed for direct connection to unpack.

Dispatches channel targeting and ramp messages for multichannel DSP line smoothing. Outputs pairs in the format target <chan> followed by <gain_value> <ramp_time>, applying the power gain curve when enabled.
Dispatches an tagged pair [tag value] whenever a dial is adjusted, where tag is the dial's custom label or 1-based index. Designed for direct connection to route.
Outputs the 1-based index of the currently active/dragged dial, followed by 0 when released.
Outputs the active number of configured dials. Ideal for dynamically setting the @chans attribute of downstream MC objects.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Output all values and channel count
method.description: Triggers output of the current channel count (outlet 4) and dumps all dial states across outlets 0, 1, 2, and 3.

method.name: float
method.description: Sets the value of the first dial according to its scaled range and triggers output.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to a float to set the first dial's position, triggering output.

method.name: list
method.description: If given a two-element list where the first element is an integer between 1 and count, it sets that specific dial's value. If given an arbitrary list of numbers, values are mapped sequentially across all active dials.

method.name: meter
method.description: Accepts a list of floating-point values between 0.0 and 1.0 representing audio signal energy across each dial's channel to render the liquid meter fill.

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating parameter inspector window. An optional argument of 1 or 0 explicitly opens or closes the window.

method.name: update
method.digest: Refresh theme from bus or persistent store
method.description: Forces the component to reload styling attributes from the shared theme bus (touch_theme_bus) or persistent dict (touch_theme_store). Also accepts aliases theme_update, refresh, and refresh_theme.

method.name: anything
method.description: If the message selector matches a dial's label tag, the dial value is updated. Otherwise, dynamically routes to attribute setters (such as min_val, max_val, multiplier, etc.).

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Selects between touch and mouse handling:
0 = Touch (discrete stepping on tap, hold-to-repeat, distance-based inertia easing on drag)
1 = Mouse (direct rotary or linear pointer drag tracking)

attribute.name: decimal_digits
attribute.description: Number of decimal places shown in numerical text readouts (0 to 8).

attribute.name: integer_digits
attribute.description: Minimum number of integer digits displayed with leading zero padding (1 to 12).

attribute.name: multiplier
attribute.description: Linear scaling coefficient applied to the scaled value before computing MC DSP gain.

attribute.name: gain_exponent
attribute.description: Exponential power curve factor applied to values sent to outlet 1 (default: 1.6). Preserves phase sign for bipolar output.

attribute.name: use_gain_curve
attribute.description: Toggles between exponential power-curve shaping (1) and linear gain multiplication (0) for outlet 1.

attribute.name: count
attribute.description: Number of active dials in the strip array (1 to 8).

attribute.name: direction
attribute.description:
Array strip layout direction:
0 = Horizontal
1 = Vertical

attribute.name: alignment
attribute.description:
Dial alignment layout mode:
0 = Strip (straight linear array)
1 = Offset Up (alternating zigzag offset shifted up/left)
2 = Offset Down (alternating zigzag offset shifted down/right)

attribute.name: dial_spacing
attribute.description: Pixel spacing distance between consecutive dials along the primary strip axis.

attribute.name: dial_size
attribute.description: Relative radius of the dial platter (0.0 to 1.0). Can be set globally or as a list of per-dial values.

attribute.name: dial_style
attribute.description:
Visual styling of the rotary indicator:
0 = Ribbon (donut rail with filled arc or line)
1 = Rail (thin guide rail with sliding orb knob and needle crossbar)

attribute.name: ribbon_fill
attribute.description:
Indicator fill type for Ribbon style:
0 = Single Line (thin radial needle indicator)
1 = Arc Fill (solid arc fill from start or center zero)

attribute.name: rotary_mode
attribute.description:
Angular span and boundary behavior:
0 = 270 (standard 270° horseshoe arc with bottom gap)
1 = 360 Top (clamped 360° circle with origin/stop at 12:00)
2 = 360 Bottom (clamped 360° circle with origin/stop at 6:00)
3 = 360 Continuous (endless continuous 360° rotary wrapping)

attribute.name: labels
attribute.description: Space-separated list of token labels applied sequentially across the dials (e.g., "Gain Freq Res Pan").

attribute.name: slider_speed
attribute.description: Sensitivity multiplier for pointer dragging and mouse wheel rotation (0.1 to 5.0).

attribute.name: step_speed_ms
attribute.description: Repeat rate in milliseconds for continuous discrete stepping when holding down in Touch mode (1 to 500 ms).

attribute.name: curve_exponent
attribute.description: Exponential factor governing distance-dependent proximity easing in Touch mode (0.0 to 2.0).

attribute.name: unit_mode
attribute.description:
Appends an automatic unit string suffix to the readout:
0 = None
1 = %
2 = dB
3 = ms
4 = Hz

attribute.name: font_name
attribute.description: Font family used to render numerical text and dial labels.

attribute.name: text_size
attribute.description: Base font point size for dial text rendering (6 to 48 pt).

attribute.name: font_style
attribute.description:
Font typography weight and slant:
0 = Regular
1 = Bold
2 = Italic
3 = Bold Italic

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description:
Text formatting filter applied to dial labels:
0 = Full (renders full string)
1 = No Vowels (removes inner vowels to save space)
2 = Caps Only (preserves uppercase letters and numbers)
3 = First Letter (abbreviates to initials)
4 = No Text (hides label text completely)

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description:
Text capitalization mode:
0 = First Cap (Title Case)
1 = All Cap (Uppercase)
2 = All Small (Lowercase)

attribute.name: borders
attribute.description: Toggles rendering of the outer chassis corner brackets (1 = ON, 0 = OFF).

attribute.name: show_background
attribute.description: Toggles solid background fill for the entire component bounding box (1 = ON, 0 = OFF).

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Corner radius in pixels for chassis borders and background panel rounding (0 to 50).

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke width in pixels of the chassis perimeter brackets.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of the chassis corner bracket arms.

attribute.name: track_breadth
attribute.description: Stroke width of the circular guide rail / arc ribbon.

attribute.name: handle_size
attribute.description: Radius in pixels of the circular handle orb when using Rail style.

attribute.name: needle_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke thickness of the radial needle indicator line.

attribute.name: bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA color for the component chassis background.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the chassis corner border brackets.

attribute.name: track_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the inactive background circular guide track.

attribute.name: handle_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the active arc fill, needle indicator, and knob orb.

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: RGBA color for the scaled numerical value readout text.

attribute.name: mode_color
attribute.description: RGBA color for dial labels and unit suffix text.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the top-right inspector launcher dot.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: RGBA background color of the floating inspector window.
